mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical Volume Price Confirmation Indicator crossing zero on completed four-hour BTC auctions marks price trend direction newly confirmed by relative volume participation; follow the new confirmed direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict upward VPCI zero crossing and short on a strict downward zero crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: VPCI multiplies long-horizon volume-weighted versus unweighted price divergence by short-horizon volume-weighted price ratio and short/long volume participation ratio. It is not PVO volume acceleration, PVT cumulative signed turnover, OBV/CVD directional accumulation, VWAP displacement alone, Force Index, OI, funding, fitted outcomes, reused events, a repair, or a promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, restricting confirmation changes to July-like volatile conditions
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour joint price-volume confirmation sign-change clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), with strictly positive summed base volume
features.event: strict VPCI zero crossing from immediately prior finite state
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical VPCI(5,20) zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no VPCI component, period, formula, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: Buff Dormeier canonical Volume Price Confirmation Indicator convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: short=5 and long=20 completed periods; VPC=long VWMA minus long SMA; VPR=short VWMA divided by short SMA; VM=short average volume divided by long average volume; VPCI=VPC*VPR*VM; strict zero crossing
external_basis.selection_use: published components, periods, multiplicative formula, zero interpretation, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
